The day of the Osaka Hai. The spectators 
are buzzing with excitement in 
anticipation of the showdown between 
Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin.

Worried about properly answering the 
crowd's cheers and delivering an intense 
race against Narita Taishin, she grew 
nervous.

Even so, in order to have the greatest 
race with her rivals, Winning Ticket 
psyched herself up and headed toward the 
race.
